scope: Local synthetic verification. Final acceptance exclusively from the frozen staged source.

attempts.result: Found and fixed a merchant/outbox lock inversion in historical reads. Provider-change receipt correctly failed strict proof; adjusted expectation. Disabled-account fixture initially violated the existing active-primary constraint.
The lock inversion and provider-change cases passed. Two new disabled-user/merchant fixtures used unsupported enum values; corrected them to deletion_pending/suspended.

Stopped the owned full-test runner during its database phase after code review found a final clock/write race. Added an atomic SQL time predicate and two tests, created a fresh disposable database, and reran all suites from a new frozen snapshot. Partial results are excluded from final acceptance.

Two concurrent-send cases were suppressed. The authorization guard still locked the outbox after the merchant parent; removed that lock too and added a deterministic competing-parent-FK test. The second full runner was stopped before database acceptance.
Forty isolated provider cases passed during diagnostic repetition; this did not replace the deterministic lock-order regression test or final full verification.
Name-filtered new delivery cases; all baseline cases are included in the final full run.
